title: Dev Expert at Quave - US Client / AI Coding Agents - Fully Remote - Expected US$8,000/month
body:
We're hiring a hands-on **Dev Expert** to lead Quave's work with a US client developing AI training and evaluation data for coding agents.

This is a **fully remote, full-time position with expected monthly compensation of US$8,000, based on 40 hours of work per week**.

You must have strong Computer Science fundamentals, deep engineering expertise in Rails or Node.js/TypeScript/React, and the ability to work independently in unfamiliar codebases.

Most client repositories use Ruby on Rails, some have React frontends, and at least one uses TypeScript, React, and Node.js throughout.
